question.text: Market Linked Debentures (MLDs), Specified Mutual Funds, unlisted debentures/bonds are treated as:

answer.text: Always short-term capital assets, irrespective of holding

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3, MLDs/SMFs/unlisted debentures/bonds are always treated as short-term irrespective of holding period. The Trap: Other treatments don't match the 2023/2024 amendment. Cross-Exam Context: Critical classification for fixed-income heavy Cat III AIFs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Flag this rule when advising on debt-oriented Cat III AIFs — tax drag is material.
